_schema: Motor soft mounts as parts — slice SM1 (track.md, Wave P follow-on). One entry is ONE MOTOR'S set of grommets: the pads under the four screws that hold one motor to its arm. Every field under `specs` is what SoftMount.spec_from_part() reads and nothing here duplicates the physics in src/propulsion/soft_mount.gd (Gent's Shore A → E, k = E·A/t per grommet, f_n = sqrt(k_total / m_supported) / 2π). The five REQUIRED fields are SoftMount.PART_SPEC_FIELDS: `shore_a` (durometer, Shore A), `contact_area_mm2` (the crushed contact patch of ONE grommet, mm²), `grommets_per_motor`, `thickness_mm` (the pad's nominal compressed thickness — what its mass is computed at; the Lab's "Motor soft mount" tweak is still the thickness an aircraft is built with) and `density_kg_m3`. An entry that leaves one out is refused with insufficient_data:missing_<field>, never filled from the class-typical default. `damping_ratio` is optional and absent from every entry: no vendor publishes one, and SoftMount's own 0.10 is a guess that says so. `assumed` lists every spec field whose value is a CLASS-TYPICAL GUESS rather than a reading of a real product, and an entry with any assumed field says "class-typical" in its `source`; tests/test_soft_mount.gd holds both to that. `mass_g` at the top level is DERIVED — SoftMount.mount_mass_kg() at the entry's own thickness, ×1000 — and is carried for the browsing rail and the loader only; the same test asserts the two agree. Colour, price and vendor links are banned by name from both tiers.

parts.name: 60A silicone grommets (class default)
parts.source: the class-typical default SoftMount has carried since P8, made a part rather than a hidden constant. 60A is what the two commodity FPV grommet products in this project's spare bin read on a Shore A gauge; four per motor is the four-M3 motor plate every quad frame in the catalog uses. The contact area (4 mm², the crushed patch of a 6 mm OD grommet), the 1.0 mm compressed thickness (pre-P8's MOUNT_REFERENCE_THICKNESS_M) and the silicone density are class-typical guesses, not readings.

parts.name: 50A soft silicone grommets
parts.source: class-typical softer grommet: the 60A default's geometry with a 50A durometer, the softer end of what is sold as motor soft-mount rubber. No product was measured; every field is a class-typical guess, which is what `assumed` says.

parts.name: 70A firm silicone grommets
parts.source: class-typical firmer grommet: the 60A default's geometry with a 70A durometer, the firm end of what is sold as motor soft-mount rubber. No product was measured; every field is a class-typical guess, which is what `assumed` says.
